answer: Require every agent to lock a small stake for a full 30-day voyage before it can earn: the deposit sits in escrow and is forfeited on early exit or proven misbehavior, while honest work slowly returns it with rewards. A sybil attacker must fund and freeze capital on each fake identity for the whole period, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand locked stakes and a month of patience. The escrow is no haven for cheats; it is a thread tying each identity to real time and real cost, and the longer the wait, the less a flood of fresh accounts can buy.
